description:
We are conducting a confidential search for an experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility in Baltimore County, MD. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on resident care and facility performance.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with state and federal regulations, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. Join a dedicated team committed to providing high-quality care and achieving operational excellence.
requirements: Active Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland
Proven experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility
Strong leadership and operational management skills
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: $115,000 - $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Part-time Medical Billing & Coding Specialist to join our team. This remote position offers the flexibility to work from home while contributing to the accurate and efficient financial operations of a healthcare organization. You will play a crucial role in ensuring proper coding and billing practices, directly impacting patient care and revenue cycle management.

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional looking for a part-time role with competitive hourly compensation. We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer flexible interview scheduling, including options Monday-Friday from 1 PM-7 PM and over the weekend as needed, to accommodate your availability.
requirements: Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) certification preferred
Proven experience in medical billing and coding within a healthcare setting
Proficiency with medical coding systems (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance
Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills

description:
We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Traveling Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) to join our team in Birmingham, AL. This part-time/PRN role offers the flexibility to work across various healthcare settings, providing essential patient care and support. We value your commitment and offer competitive compensation for your skills.

As a Traveling CNA, you will play a crucial role in assisting patients with daily living activities, monitoring vital signs, and ensuring a comfortable and safe environment. Your ability to adapt to different facility environments and provide consistent, high-quality care will be key to your success.

We are actively scheduling interviews for this urgent opening, with availability Monday-Friday from 1 PM-7 PM, and over the weekend as needed, to accommodate your schedule.
requirements: Proven experience as a CNA in a healthcare setting
Ability to travel to different facility locations as required
Flexibility to work part-time/PRN shifts, including weekends
